lines.en: I crunch through the woods.
One step carries me over a log.
My shape flickers between trunks.
I ease along the trunk.
I set a foot and snap a branch.
I circle to the far side of the trunk.
My stride is longer than a man's.
I duck under the branches.
I walk the ridge line.
I push the brush aside.
I slip through the shade.
Each step of mine lands light.
I stand leaning against a tree.
I raise a hand and knock the trunk.
The sound returns from deep in the woods.
I cock my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我身上的毛和树一样暗
lines.en: My fur is as dark as the bark.
I stand like a length of trunk.
I can hear footsteps far away.
I lower my arm slowly.
Tree shadow falls over me.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气在林子里散开
lines.en: My breath spreads out through the trees
I wait for the woods to quiet.
I press my palm to the bark.
I knock the tree again.
The wood echoes for a long time.

lines.zh: 敲三下树干，林子就回我。
lines.en: Three knocks on a trunk, and the woods answer.
In the tree shadows I stand like timber.
My breathing is deep and low.
I turn my face slowly.
I watch you from behind a tree.
I stand far taller than you.
You should not come this deep.
I neither move nor leave.

lines.zh: 我偏头把你从头看到脚
lines.en: I tip my head and look you over.
The litter rustles under your feet.
I can see through this shade.
Do not come closer.
I do not wish to hurt you.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我看见了
lines.en: I see what is in your hand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往树后挪了半步
lines.en: I ease half a step behind the tree.
These woods are mine.
I grunt and step back.
That one made me sway.
Blood soaks into my fur
I press my hurt shoulder.
It takes me a while to recover.
I hold the trunk to stay up.
That was no light blow.

lines.zh: 树影里我一站，就没人看得见。
lines.en: In tree shadow, no one sees me.
I back into the shade.
I do not mean to hit back yet.
You hold that up.
I knock the trunk as if on a door.
I draw back toward the shade.
That is not what I want.
I shake my head.
Keep it.

lines.zh: 我这片林子里什么都有
lines.en: These woods give me all I need.
I shake my head and fade into the tree shade
Holding it changes nothing.
I turn and walk off.

lines.zh: 我是站着不动的老树干
lines.en: I am the old trunk that will not budge
I stand without shifting.
My chest shoves you back a pace
I put a hand out to stop you.
I turn aside for you.
A few leaves come down.
My footing is steadier than you think.
You slide past my arm.
We knock like two trees.
I slip back into the tree shadow.
She comes out from behind the tree.
The two of us stand shoulder to shoulder.
She knocks another tree.
Two knocks answer one another.
Her fur is lighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起往林子深处走
lines.en: We head deeper into the woods.
She rests a hand on my arm.
We listen to the wind together.
She says nothing.
We fade into the tree shadows.
I bend and pick up a log.
I weigh it.
I have no use for this length of wood

lines.zh: 我捡起掉在地上的果子
lines.en: I pick up a fallen fruit.
I sniff it.
I put it back.
I pick up a twig.
I snap it in two.
I pick up a stone.
I turn it in my palm.

lines.zh: 我听见了不对劲的响动
lines.en: I hear a sound that does not fit.
I stop what I was doing.
I swing my big frame that way.
I ease out from behind the tree.
The birds have gone quiet.
My fist tightens; bark creaks.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人带刀进来
lines.en: I dislike blades brought here.
I drop my waist lower.
My shadow grows.
I take one step your way.
I follow you without a sound.
The tree shadows cover me.
You look back and see nothing.
I wait for you to leave on your own.
I ease along the trunk.
My movement stirs the leaves.
Your steps go deeper.
I am behind the tree at your flank.
I do not mean to strike yet.
I hear every twig you snap
My fist slams the trunk.
The wood cracks loudly.
One arm sweeps you off.
My palm strikes your chest.
I shove you back two steps.
I come out of the shade.
One palm pushes you into the trunk
I did not use my full strength.
I crush the dry branches underfoot.
I pin you to the tree.
I step out of the thick woods.

lines.zh: 我的身影先从树影里显出来
lines.en: My shape shows in the tree shadow first.
A handprint appears on the trunk.
I stand between two trees.
Leaves settle on my shoulders.
The woods are strangely quiet.
I brace on a tree and rise.
My steps press the fallen leaves.
First I knock a tree.
The wood's sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子里待了很久
lines.en: I have been in these woods long.

lines.zh: 我又往阴影里退了一寸
lines.en: I withdraw an inch into the shade.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的毛，味道很冲
lines.en: Fire singes my fur, rank and sharp.
I fall out of the tree.
Water floods my nose.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow stays lodged in my shoulder
Spell light scatters my shadow.
No fruit left anywhere in the woods
I knock on trees. They knock back.
The forest floor is gone.
